payout_quote: Official promo (Sep 1, 2026 – Dec 31, 2026): $350 when you open Priority Banking (Gold/Platinum checking), $100 when you upgrade to Priority Banking, $50 when you open Pure Checking — with new direct deposit(s) of $500+ posting within 60 days of opening.
timing: One-time statement credit issued the month following the month you meet the criteria.
steps: Confirm you are in First Hawaiian Bank's eligibility footprint (HI/GU/CNMI; CA expansion — confirm before applying).
Between 9/1/2026 and 12/31/2026, open Priority Banking Gold/Platinum ($350), upgrade to Priority Banking ($100), or open Pure Checking ($50) at https://www.fhb.com/en/personal/checking.
Have new direct deposit(s) of $500+ (payroll, pension, SS, or government benefits — not P2P, tax refunds, or wires) post within 60 days of opening.

Keep the account open and not overdrawn for at least 180 days (early close triggers a $50–$75 fee); the one-time statement credit lands the month after you meet the criteria (reported as taxable income).
catches: Tiered by product: $350 = open Priority Banking Gold/Platinum; $100 = upgrade to Priority Banking; $50 = open Pure Checking.
Requires new direct deposit(s) of $500+ posting within 60 days of opening — qualifying = recurring ACH payroll/pension/SS/government benefits; P2P (Venmo/PayPal), tax refunds, and wires excluded.
Closing or converting the account within 180 days triggers a $75 (Priority) or $50 (Pure) account closing fee.
Monthly service charges: $15 Gold / $25 Platinum / $4 Pure (waivable); bonus reported as taxable income.
Limited to one per customer and account; account must be open and not overdrawn at payout; promo expires 12/31/2026 (earlier 1/1/26–4/30/26 promo is expired).
Eligibility footprint is historically HI/GU/CNMI (FHB is expanding in California — confirm your footprint before applying).
biggest_catch: The top $350 requires opening Priority Banking (with $15–$25 monthly service charges if not waived) — the basic Pure Checking pays only $50.
eligibility: New/upgrade FHB checking customers 18+; historically HI/GU/CNMI residents (CA expansion in progress — confirm); promo window 9/1/2026–12/31/2026.
